messages:
elaine: Quick ask from marketing: were finalizing the launch blog and need a fast bench sanity across a few model variants. Can eng/runtime run a smoke and confirm methodology?

mike: We need coldstart p95/p99, embed batch latency for hero payloads, and fp16 vs 8bit comparison. Two sanitized example outputs for the blog would be great.

sam: Send payloads and model names + preferred region. Also warmup policy?

elaine: Payloads: short support summarizer; long ~2k-token convo; embed batch (20 items). Models: rwd-1-xl-fp16, rwd-1-xl-8bit, rwd-2-base-fp16. Region: us-west1.

elaine: ```
short: {"prompt":"Summarize user's issue and suggest two fixes."}
long: [{"role":"user","content":"...long message..."}, ... ]
embed: ["s1","s2",... up to 20]
```

tara: Warmup affects coldstart numbers. Please run both 30s and 5m warmup so marketing can illustrate sensitivity.

beth: Capture tokenization time separately for the long convo so we don't conflate it with model decode tail.

sam: Plan: 200 samples per payload for a smoke (3600 requests total). capture p50/p95/p99, tokenization split, and attach 2-3 traces for p99 outliers. Will also run 1k offline for validation.

elaine: Timeline: smoke numbers + two example outputs by EOD Thursday. Add one-line caveat: "smoke sample; internal 1k validates p99 within ~10%" unless you see otherwise.

runtime-bot: queue accepted. sam owns runs, tara validates artifacts.

sam: Starting now. ETA Thursday 6pm PST (4790009150). Will post summary here. :rocket:
